written: before any passage was read, authored, rendered or rated
hypothesis: Putting a reported line in a balloon tied to its speaker (says / partnerSays) lets a muted viewer see WHO says WHAT to WHOM, raising CORRECT+ADDS on the beats where a line is said, without raising WRONG or dead frames.

change.code: 34596178 (schema says, SpeechBalloon, planner, merge verbatim check, readcheck)
change.rules: the SPEECH section of storyboard.js, in rules.md only for arm B (prep with STORYBOARD_SPEECH=1)

arms.A: fresh author, current rules.md (no speech section)
arms.B: fresh author, rules.md + SPEECH section, same author prompt
arms.both: same prep, same planner/renderer code (34596178), same routine merge-fix round(s); no director step

passages.draw: audit/c8-pilots/select-speech-passages.js: windows of 12 beats with >= 2 beats whose narration has a speech verb (relaxed from 3 before reading: 3 yielded 2 books), never a mute-sampled beat, not the first/last 5%, no overlap (+-2) with cycle-7 windows; seeded per slug; books in a fixed order
passages.excluded: we-were-liars 151-162: it is the reference book whose art.json rules.md tells authors to read (contamination risk); beloved, wonder, how-to-talk-to-anyone, the-art-of-saying-no: no window

frames: one still per scene longer than 2 s at 60% of the scene from arm A's config (identical frames, segmentation verified equal), caption layer off

primary.instrument: official procedure: per passage x arm a fresh sonnet describer (PROMPTS §1 verbatim), per passage a fresh sonnet judge in --vs mode (X/Y random, JUDGE_RULES verbatim), 2 independent replicates

all: WRONG(B) <= WRONG(A) in EACH genre, pooled
on the SPEECH frames (frames whose scene in arm B carries a balloon): CORRECT+ADDS(B) >= CORRECT+ADDS(A) + ceil(15% of those judged items)
overall ADDS(B) >= ADDS(A) and CORRECT(B) >= CORRECT(A) and EXPLAINS(B) >= EXPLAINS(A), pooled
shipRule.else: NO SHIP: the speech rules stay off (the code stays dark)

secondary.instrument: cloud 3-frame strips with the sequence rubric, reported per arm and for the speech frames; cannot bypass the primary

secondRater: cloud API official rubric on the same stills, report-only (P2: never decides)
